fields.help: Field holding the list to split; several fields comma-separated. Dot paths reach nested fields (user.addresses). Use $binary to split an item's binary files into separate items.
fields.label: Fields To Split Out

fields.help: Which other fields of the input item to copy onto each new item.
fields.label: Include

fields.help: Comma-separated fields copied onto each new item.
fields.label: Fields To Include

fields.help: Output field for the split values; one per split field, comma-separated. Empty: object elements are merged into the item and other values keep the field name.
fields.label: Destination Field Name

fields.help: Treat field names literally instead of as parent.child paths.
fields.label: Disable Dot Notation

fields.help: Copy the input item's binary data onto every new item.
fields.label: Include Binary

outputs.description: one item per element of the split list: the element under the destination name (or the field's name); an object element with include no_other_fields and no destination becomes the item itself
include all_other_fields: the input item's other fields; selected_other_fields: the fields in fields_to_include
